description: macOS-style Windows Dynamic Island with media controls, notifications, microphone indicators, window shelf, virtual-desktop support, and per-monitor islands.
pre_uninstall: catch { Write-Warning "Dynamic Island cleanup command '$argument' failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
Write-Warning 'The DynamicIsland scheduled task still exists. Its registry state was preserved; remove the task from Task Scheduler if it was not removed after the elevation prompt.'
Write-Warning 'Notification banner backup data remains under HKCU:\Software\DynamicIsland\HiddenBanners and was preserved so it can still be restored.'
notes: The official v0.8.0 release is an Inno Setup installer. The upstream installer/DynamicIsland.iss defines DynamicIsland.exe as the app executable and packages the contents of the self-contained publish directory directly under {app}; Scoop uses innosetup=true to extract that payload without executing the vendor's installation, registry, startup, or uninstall sections.

This application is classified Nonportable because its own startup code applies Windows integration: on Windows 11 build 22621 or later it sets HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\EnableSnapBar to 0 and restarts Explorer once. Its default notification settings also hide native Windows notification banners while the island is running; a normal exit restores them. The app stores data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\DynamicIsland.

pre_uninstall requests a clean app exit, removes the app's optional scheduled startup task, restores notification banners, and removes the Snap Layouts override when the app's own tweak marker confirms it applied the change. It preserves any remaining notification backup or scheduled-task state rather than deleting it blindly. User data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\DynamicIsland is intentionally retained.
